title: Command
description: DESIGN-level schema. Represents a requested or approved Command per architecture/security/AI_AUTHORITY_CONTRACT.md. No executor implementation exists yet.

commandId.description: Unique identifier for this command instance.

requestedAction.description: Parameterized description of the intended effect. Fields are capability-specific and not enumerated here.

policyId.description: Reference to the Policy evaluated for this command.

approval.description: Populated only when policyDecision is REQUIRE_APPROVAL and a human has responded.

executor.description: Identifier of the Deterministic Executor responsible for carrying out this command, if ALLOW/APPROVED.
